definition.description:
Get upcoming corporate-action dates for one company or a watchlist, sorted by date.

Covers subscription and payment dates, record dates, new-share listings, conversion,
warrant, and exchange windows, short-sale restrictions around rights issues, buyback
and disposal periods, shareholder meetings, dissent and appraisal-rights windows,
trading suspensions, merger or split effective dates, and bond maturities. Dates come
from major-issue and registration filings of the past year (three years for bond
filings), with the latest amended terms. Debt maturities from periodic reports list
only recently issued securities; a note gives corporate bonds due within a year.
horizon counts forward from today; include_past adds recent dates. Use
get_corporate_events for full deal terms and get_debt_profile for the full ladder.

bonds, buybacks and treasury-stock trusts, capital reductions, mergers, splits, share

and registered offerings. Each event has a headline, normalized key terms, dated

Returns a maturity ladder of outstanding corporate bonds, short-term bonds, commercial
paper, hybrid securities, and contingent capital securities in common remaining-maturity
buckets, the share due within a year, and the issuance record with coupons, ratings,

Search OpenDART's upstream services for call_service. A last resort.

Every service is already served by a topical tool that resolves companies and
periods and labels its results, and each match names that tool under covered_by;
prefer it. Use this only when no other tool returns the data you need, such as a
field the topical tools omit. Matching uses words from service titles and
descriptions plus shorthand such as CB, BW, or buyback; without a query every
callable service is listed. Results show each parameter and the values it accepts.

query.description: Keywords such as 'convertible bond'; omit to list all.

definition.title: List OpenDART services

definition.description:
Open an original filing: its outline, one page of its text, or passages matching terms.

Documents are the Korean originals; headings and table labels are given in English
where the filing provides them, and you translate the prose. Start with the outline to
see sections and attachments, then read a section by ID or alias one page at a time,
following next_offset, or search it: Korean terms such as 전환사채 find body text,
English terms match headings and labels. Use it for KRX disclosures, business
descriptions, notes, and anything the structured tools lack. Large reports can take a
minute to download the first time; if told the download is still in progress, repeat
the same call.

definition.title: Read a filing

definition.description:
List filings newest first, for one company or the whole market: what was filed.

Filter by category (annual_report, major_issues, major_holding_report, fair_disclosure,
and others), date window, listing market, and title text. Use it to see what a company
filed recently, to scan the market for one kind of filing, and to find filing numbers
for read_filing. KRX ad hoc and fair disclosures, such as supply contracts, guidance,
and preliminary earnings, are reachable only here and through read_filing. Without a
company the window is limited to three months. title_contains scans a bounded number
of the newest filings and says when it could not cover the whole window. For the
decoded terms of capital raises, convertible bonds, buybacks, or mergers, use
get_corporate_events.

company.description: Company name, stock code, or corp code; omit to search every company.

final_only.description: Only the latest version of amended filings.

market.description: Restrict to a listing market, or to unlisted companies.

title_contains.description: Text the English title must contain.

until.description: End: ISO date or relative; default today (KST).
